This is a statement from the ministry of Justice of Blarfghanistan.

Tonight at 2:36am a plane from Hydonia landed. That in of itself is noting new and, thanks to our surging tourism industry, quite common what is of note today is the passenger within.

In a massive collaboration of the BIS (Blarfghanistan intelligence service) and the BMJ (Blarfghanistani Ministry of Justice) alongside our great friends and allies over in Hydronia we were able to capture one of the highest profile criminals in Blarfghanistani History.

Welphred Jost, the leader of our nations largest forced labour camps during the time of the Schuhmann regime. Has been captured after he was discovered hiding amongst the noble people of Hydronia. But, like a roach amongst butterflies, his discovery was inevitable. 
While there were many scum of the earth who attempted to profit from Schuhmanns privatized penal system, none were as depraved as Jost. Historians and Statisticians can, to this day, only estimate a minimum of how many people died as direct result of Josts prison policies. But at least 30.000 citizens met their end due to the horrible conditions of their internment.

Jost is currently transferred to Zemipol 2 where he will be held until his trial begins.

The prosecution is planning on trying him under our new GaL (Government absence law) which will retroactively bring justice without a need to confine the prosecution to at the time laws which would have been those enacted by Schuhmann. 

His charges include but arent limited to
§14d I 1 GaL Mass murder
§2 I GaL Tyranny 
§18 II  GaL collective punishment 
and §1 GaL crimes against Dignity

It is this administrations goal to bring justice to the survivors and the families of the victims. This will set an example to anyone who profited under Schuhmanns cruelty that their time is ticking and they better pray to any god still pitiful enough to hear them to have mercy on their wretched souls because we wont.

Glory to Blarfghanistan, Glory to the people.

[i][b]Java Jakitl Mecu Boeing 747 Crashed[/b]

On March 30, the passage of 660 [nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation], [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation], [nation]United Hydronia[/nation], and [nation]New Westmore[/nation] crashed into Unknown Island([nation]Blobon[/nation]). The last reports came that an unpredicted storm made one of the pilots turn to the nearest island. The Unknown Island was off-limits to any airline, since an unpredicted storm made no patrol aircraft to warn the crew. Many of the crew have no choice but to land a hard crash. Their last connection was at 2:30 am, and they were sent in at 8:30 am on the morning of March 31. Its still unknown where specific locations were, but detail was made in their last log of the crash.

Follow records reads

( 2:30 Am) Pilot- We hit an unpredicted storm. We're calling for Indonocaismnic National Post-Guards to get us help in this storm. Going to have land on this nearby island in the middle of the Shamat Sea.

( 2:41 Am)Copilot- O God, we're going down! 

Cuts of short records*

The Indonocaismnic National Post-Guards have begun to search the unknown island. Many of those who know the island nickname this island the Shaluik Island or Skull of Death. This island holds many unknowns and even one story of a Documentary Team who visited the island and was rumored to have found a hostile intelligence being, but still likely to be unknown since the island holds uninhabitable places due to its storms and harsh treatment. 

Indonocaismnic National Post-Guards and Military Reserve have been deployed to find the missing Java Jakitl Mecu Boeing 747. Will try our best to find Java Jakitl Mecu Boeing 747 survival for 24/7 hrs.

[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;58961464][b]Establishment of the Erene Economic and Humanitarian Pact (EEHP)[/b]

[i]Today the Minister of the United Lavian Republic is sending out a call for a economic pact spanning the world to not only better connect the nations of Erene, but to also help deny monetary or political gain to those who violate human rights and suppress their people. This pact looks to help better connect the world economically and ethically through the following points, to be made clear or adjusted once nations have adequately joined and the debate process can begin, with a set of ground principals to base off of:[/i]

[b]1. Open borders and ports:[/b] The members of the EEHP will share open borders with each other. In practice, this means citizens of each nation will have the privilege of traveling passport and visa free, with the potential of streamlined immigration between members. This brings the benefit of increased tourism and a larger sense of collaboration between members. Members will also have open port policies with the other members, meaning a decrease in docking fees allowing for ease of business between members.

[b]2. Sharing of business licenses and integration of international safety standards:[/b]Members of the EEHP will share the same level of safety standards and regulations, thus allowing for companies to be licensed in one country and use that license across all nations in the EEHP rather than having to get multiple licenses and concern themselves with different laws and safety standards. This will not only help companies, but also ensure that ethical practices in EEHP countries will be encouraged.

[b]3. Sharing of innovations and breakthroughs:[/b] EEHP members will share practices with each other to not only benefit members, but also build a better Erene for current and future generations. This includes the sharing of the best industry practices to prevent environmental impact via pollution, deforestation, over-farming/fishing, and also share stake in world wide conservation projects of natural habitats and cultural sites. Breakthroughs in industries will also be shared between nations, allowing for better industry practices across the world.

[b]4. Implement tariffs and import restrictions on nations that promote unethical practices or undemocratic principals:[/b] Membership in the EEHP not only looks to benefit the nations in it, but to benefit the world via lowering and hopefully removing reliance on fascist nations or those ruled by dictators (not including constitutional monarchies, parliamentary monarchies, or similar governments that practice the basics of democracy and good humanitarian practices.) Stemming the reliance on child labor and the exploitation of workers via taxing the imports from these nations will hopefully encourage the nations that use these practices to pivot to more sustainable and humanitarian based practices. The first and second points of this charter will also help ease the transition from the companies that use these practices by making the shipment of resources between members cheaper and more accessible to companies in the member nations.

[b]5. Promotion of humanitarian practices:[/b] Humanitarian laws to be practiced and imposed in member nations include but are not limited to: 
- Laws against exclusion of people based on their race, gender, sexuality, or religion
- Freedom of religion
- Freedom of speech (specifics to be determined by the founding members)
- Minimum wage laws (to be determined by the individual country)
- Limit on maximum hours of work before overtime pay begins
- Free school for at least up until grade/year 8 in less developed countries, and free high school for the more developed countries (university/college is up to the individual country to decide)
These policies will be helped via an aid fund to be contributed to by each government via a number of % of their GDP to help other member nations with disasters or modernization

Invited members include:
[nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation]
[nation]Sikirsk[/nation]
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]New Westmore[/nation]
[nation]Goleornacha Roleplay Posts[/nation]
Membership is not restricted to these nations and the ULR encourages people to apply for membership, this list is simply a list of countries the ULR knows are respectable and has good relations with already. It should also be clarified that this will not interject with any military alliances, however if one member attacks another, or a nation attacks a member and another member state joins the attack, the attacking member will be removed from the pact if the member does not provide ample reason for such action.[/quote]

Sikirsk accepts your invitation.
